items.title: Nancy Wilson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Arsenio opened for me... John made things happen for him... Arsenio was nice enough to ask me. 'I need Michael Wolff and' – so I said, of course.

ctx.x: For those who don’t know the story.

Arsenio opened for me. I never heard the name, didn’t know who it was. I say it was Cleveland. He says it was someplace else. But anyway, I heard the last bit of his routine, and I was in hysterics. I was hysterical. It was so funny. The Pips without Gladys. It was just absolutely hysterical, and I told John about it. He opened – started opening for me. Then we got him to come to California, and John made things happen for him. So he always realizes and acknowledges the fact that Nancy Wilson is the one who…
